final.summary:
Audit complete. I inspected the workbook, received a workbook-wide repair contract, and fixed three high-confidence formula range errors that all stemmed from AVERAGE ranges that wrongly included blank or non-peer cells:

| Cell | Before | After | Why |
|------|--------|-------|-----|
| **DCF!I15** | `AVERAGE($F$15:$H$15)` | `AVERAGE($G$15:$H$15)` | F15 is blank/nonnumeric; the contiguous aggregate block is G15:H15. |
| **WACC!D7** | `AVERAGE('Exhibit 6'!D36:J36)` | `AVERAGE('Exhibit 6'!E36:J36)` | D36 names the subject company; the peer comparables average starts at E36. |
| **WACC!D14** | `AVERAGE('Exhibit 9'!M8:M26/100)` | `AVERAGE('Exhibit 9'!M8:M22/100)` | M23:M26 are blank; the longest contiguous aggregate block is M8:M22. |

All three were written through managed locked writes (CAS v1→v2) and passed post-write verification. The "Incorrect Average" filename clue was confirmed by evidence: every defect was an average range that swallowed the wrong cells. No further issues were flagged in the inspected scope; unrelated formatting/validation work would be reported separately if requested.
